title: Add live peer-mismatched delegated repair denial coverage
summary: A2A repair authorization has daemon-level policy coverage, but delegated repair must also have live daemon and CLI evidence before the status can advance beyond a blocked expansion boundary.
expectedFailureModes: Delegated repair policy stays unit-tested only, leaving live daemon wiring unproven.
A live peer can reach repair mutation paths using a capability scoped to the wrong counterparty.
Status docs claim delegated repair denial evidence without a live coverage entry or validator hook.
humanEscalation: Human review is required before delegated repair automation is enabled for cross-peer operators.
nextAction: Add opt-in live coverage that attempts delegated A2A repair with a peer-mismatched capability scope, proves the daemon denies the mutation, records the evidence in live coverage metadata, and updates A2A repair status docs without enabling delegated repair automation.
